latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of "frontend-design" skill.

- Enables creation of distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces and components with strong, clear aesthetic direction.
- Provides guidelines for bold design choices, including unique typography, color themes, spatial composition, and motion effects.
- Focuses on avoiding generic AI aesthetics in favor of creative and memorable UI solutions.
- Encourages thoughtful design thinking informed by project purpose, audience, technical constraints, and differentiation.
- Supports multiple frontend implementations (HTML/CSS/JS, React, Vue) with an emphasis on implementable, production-ready code.
